title: 50agents vs Gumloop: AI agent builders compared | 50agents
description: Gumloop is a team AI agent builder from $37 a month after a trial; 50agents starts free and builds automations, AI agents and apps. Every row sourced.
answer: Pick Gumloop if your team builds and shares AI agents under IT control, with a code sandbox and a cloud browser that keeps saved logins.
Pick 50agents if you want to start free and get the right kind of thing for each job, an automation, AI agent, browser agent or app, from plain words.
ask: Set up a browser agent that checks my competitors' pricing pages every day at 9:00 and tells me when a price changes
lede: Gumloop is the stronger AI agent platform for a company; 50agents gives smaller teams the right kind for each job, built from plain words.

us: You want to try it free, with no card.
Some jobs should be fixed steps that cost little to run, not an AI agent each time.
You need an app with records and screens, worked by a crew of AI agents.
them: IT needs to control which tools and models each person may use.
Your AI agents must work behind logins, with a credential vault and a browser you can take over.
You need code in your AI agents.

move.title: Copy each AI agent's instructions
move.body: We found no export for Gumloop AI agents on Gumloop's own pages, so copy each one's instructions, tools and model as your record.

move.title: Ask Captain for the outcome
move.body: Paste the AI agent's instructions as the ask. Captain may suggest an automation instead where the steps never change, and says why.

move.title: Switch at the end of the period
move.body: Gumloop credits do not roll over (except on Enterprise), so cancel before renewal.

faqs.q: Does 50agents have a browser agent like Gumloop?
faqs.a: Yes, for websites with no app to connect. It runs on a schedule and leaves a report; Gumloop's browser adds a credential vault and lets you take over the session.
To try, 50agents, which is free to start. Gumloop is $37 a month for 20,000 credits after a 14-day trial that needs a card.
Gumloop's homepage cites 100+ MCP integrations; 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket. The two numbers count different things.
